This arrangement does NOT cover the obligations that are independent of Annex III — prohibited practices under Article #, transparency under Article #, AI literacy under Article # — which remain due today. The slightest significant change in design removes the grandfathering and makes the full regime applicable.

texte.Chaque jalon facturé est payable à récep: Each invoiced milestone is payable on receipt of the invoice, according to the payment schedule spread over two equal monthly instalments. In accordance with Articles L.#-# and D.#-# of the French Commercial Code, any late payment incurs penalties at three times the legal interest rate and a flat-rate recovery indemnity of €#. Amounts are stated exclusive of tax; VAT at # % (No FR # # # #) is added to the amounts invoiced.
texte.Chaque juridiction est évaluée sur ces #: Each jurisdiction is assessed on these # criteria (scale #-#). The overall score displayed is a weighted average. For the major jurisdictions, the detail per criterion can be consulted via the “View details” button on the profile.
texte.Chaque ligne va du point « formés » au p: Each line runs from the “trained” point to the “working there” point; the arrow gives the direction and the right-hand column the balance. The United States trains # % of the world elite and employs # % — +# points; China trains # % and employs only # %. It is a quantified argument for an executive committee. A HOLLOW circle flags a value that the source does not publish: the balance is then declared not computable, never shown as zero.
texte.Chaque pont nomme les articles ISO conce: Each bridge names the ISO clauses concerned: that is what makes it actionable — you know what to reopen. If you are already ISO # certified, first read the bridge to #: it lists exactly what grafts on. Beware of the most common trap of this graft — the scope of the AI management system is NOT that of the information security management system.
